narrative.intro: Black Construction Tutor Perini has $710M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Black Construction Tutor Perini won 14 awards so far in the current fiscal year, with an average award size of $50.7M. Obligations are up 448.3% year over year for the current fiscal period. Year-by-year obligations show $98.5M in FY21, $286M in FY22, $71.2M in FY23, $228M in FY24, $129M in FY25, and $710M in FY26. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction is the dominant market for Black Construction Tutor Perini, accounting for $703M of obligations in FY2026 to date. New Multifamily Housing Construction (except For-Sale Builders) accounted for $7.2M. The current-year totals are partial because the period is fiscal year to date, and the note clarifies that all figures are contract obligations except award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which appear as total contract values. This snapshot shows concentrated exposure to building construction and a small presence in multifamily housing during the current fiscal year.

Black Construction Tutor Perini has $710M in total FY2026 obligations, so most FY2026 dollars are in that single NAICS market. sections.heading: How have obligations trended for Black Construction Tutor Perini over recent fiscal years?
sections.body: Black Construction Tutor Perini obligations rose to $710M in FY26 from $129M in FY25, reflecting an increase of up 448.3% year over year for the current period. Black Construction Tutor Perini obligations were $98.5M in FY21, $286M in FY22, $71.2M in FY23, and $228M in FY24, showing variability across fiscal years.
